fields.description: What the mission needs: a vehicle, fuel, tarpaulins, per-diem, a hall to meet in. Free text, because the range of things a national society mobilises is not a vocabulary this app can usefully close.
fields.label: Resource

fields.description: When it is needed. Optional: a resource needed for the whole mission has no single date, and saying so by leaving this empty is more honest than repeating the start date.
fields.label: Needed On

fields.description: How many. A Float rather than an Int because the things a mission budgets for are not all countable in wholes: litres of fuel, days of hire, kilometres.
fields.label: Quantity

fields.description: What the quantity counts: litres, days, vehicles, person-days. Free text rather than a Link to ERPNext's UOM register, because vmmsx requires only onerc_core and must not grow a dependency on an accounting app to write a terms of reference.
fields.label: Unit

fields.description: The cost of one unit, in the society's own currency. Recorded because a terms of reference is what a society takes to a donor, and a resource list with no figures is not one. Nothing in this app totals these across a project or reconciles them against what was actually spent: money paid to volunteers flows through VMMS Stipend Payment Form, which is anchored to a geography and a period rather than to a mission, and bridging the two is a decision nobody has taken.
fields.label: Unit Cost

fields.description: Quantity times unit cost, computed on save and never typed. Read-only for the same reason every derived field in this app is: a figure somebody can edit independently of the two numbers it comes from is a figure that will eventually disagree with them.
fields.label: Total Cost

fields.description: Who is expected to fund this line. Free text, because vmmsx holds no donor register and inventing one here would be a second place to keep a list that a society's finance system already keeps.
fields.label: Donor
